article.linkText: Big Ten matchup features No. 18 Oregon taking on Michigan
article.story: Michigan (5-4) at No. 18 Oregon (6-3), Nov. 14 at 3:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Oregon by 10.5. Against the spread: Oregon 4-5, Michigan 3-6. How to watch: Fox Sports 1 Key stats Oregon Offense Overall: 422 yards per game (37th in FBS) Passing: 285.4 yards per game (14th) Rushing: 136.6 yards per game (96th) Scoring: 34.1 points per game (29th) Oregon Defense Overall: 349.7 yards per game (58th in FBS) Passing: 224.9 yards per game (85th) Rushing: 124.8 yards per game (40th) Scoring: 22.1 points per game (49th) Michigan Offense Overall: 302.6 yards per game (132nd in FBS) Passing: 173.9 yards per game (125th) Rushing: 128.7 yards per game (109th) Scoring: 19.6 points per game (126th) Michigan Defense Overall: 255.3 yards per game (4th in FBS) Passing: 154.8 yards per game (4th) Rushing: 100.6 yards per game (18th) Scoring: 16.2 points per game (14th) Oregon is 89th in third down percentage, converting 37.5% of the time. Michigan ranks 32nd on defense, allowing its opponents to convert at 33.9%. Michigan ranks 132nd in the FBS with a -8 turnover margin, compared to Oregon's 65th-ranked even margin. Michigan is 131st in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 95.7% of trips. Oregon's red zone offense ranks 5th, scoring on 95.1% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Oregon Passing: Dylan Raiola, 1,354 yards, 11 TDs, 2 INTs, 65.4 completion percentage Rushing: Dierre Hill Jr., 474 yards on 96 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Dakorien Moore, 601 yards on 48 catches, 7 TDs Michigan Passing: Bryce Underwood, 924 yards, 5 TDs, 6 INTs, 58.1 completion percentage Rushing: Savion Hiter, 331 yards on 93 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: J.J. Buchanan, 646 yards on 40 catches, 5 TDs Last game Oregon beat Ohio State 41-28 on Nov. 7. Raiola threw for 257 yards on 25-of-40 attempts (62.5%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. Hill had 75 rushing yards on 13 carries and two touchdowns, adding four receptions for 31 yards. Moore recorded 56 yards on seven catches with one touchdown. Michigan fell to Michigan State 15-6 on Nov. 7. Tommy Carr passed for 138 yards on 14-of-26 attempts (53.8%) with no touchdowns and two interceptions. Bryson Kuzdzal carried the ball nine times for 49 yards, adding two receptions for seven yards. Travis Johnson put up 38 yards on three catches. Next game Oregon plays at Michigan State on Nov. 20. Michigan hosts No. 4 UCLA on Nov. 21.
